title: WritersProof Cognitive Markers Assertion
description: C2PA custom assertion containing deep behavioral analysis across 5 forensic dimensions. Label: com.writerslogic.cognitive-markers

cognitiveLoad.description: IKI-surprisal entanglement analysis: correlation between keystroke timing and linguistic complexity

ikiSurprisalRho.description: Spearman rho between IKI and word surprisal. Cognitive 0.3-0.6, transcriptive ~0

sentenceArcRSquared.description: Quadratic fit R-squared to per-sentence velocity. Cognitive >0.3

structuralPauseConcentration.description: Gaussian proximity of deep pauses to sentence/paragraph boundaries. Cognitive >0.6

revisionTopology.description: DAG structure analysis of edit positions and revision classification

meanBranchingFactor.description: Unique edit targets per source position. Cognitive >2, transcriptive ~1

meanRevisitDepth.description: Edit count per active region. Cognitive 2-4

meanFrontierDistance.description: Fraction behind max cursor. Cognitive 0.3-0.6, transcriptive <0.05

activeRegionCount.description: Document regions receiving edits (20 position bins)

detourRatio.description: Non-sequential cursor jumps / total chars. Transcription ~0, composition 0.3-1.5+

leadingEdgeDivergence.description: Fraction of edits behind frontier. Transcription ~0%, composition 15-40%

insertionPointEntropy.description: Shannon entropy of behind-edge insertions. Transcription <1.5, composition 2.5-4.0

positionalInsertionPct.description: Insertions at positions behind the frontier

errorEcology.description: Distribution of error types -- motor errors (cognitive) vs. visual/bulk errors (transcriptive)

falseStartPct.description: Type 2-4 chars rapidly then delete and retype. Cognitive reference: 0.20

jsdFromCognitive.description: Jensen-Shannon divergence from cognitive reference distribution. Lower = more cognitive

jsdFromTranscriptive.description: Jensen-Shannon divergence from transcriptive reference. Lower = more transcriptive

likelihoodModel.description: Per-window Bayesian classification using windowed log-likelihood ratios

sessionLlr.description: Sum of per-window log-likelihood ratios. Positive = cognitive

llrStdDev.description: Std dev of window LLRs. Higher = mixed session

outOfFocusRatio.description: Fraction of editing time with document unfocused

midTypingSwitchRatio.description: Switches within 2s of a keystroke. Cognitive >0.5

editMetrics.description: Edit position distribution and entropy measures

monotonicAppendRatio.description: Fraction of edits at >95% position. High = append-only (suspicious)

editEntropy.description: Shannon entropy of 20-bin edit position histogram

timingEntropy.description: Shannon entropy of inter-keystroke intervals. Threshold: 3.0 bits

pauseEntropy.description: Shannon entropy of pause durations. Threshold: 2.0 bits

deletionClustering.description: Nearest-neighbor distance ratio. Below 1 = clustered deletions
